mechanism.rotations: R(t)=R0 Exp(t Log(R0^T R1)); translations linear; canonical SO3 metric trace/2
mechanism.predictor: Clean endpoint prediction converted to a tangent vector with log/(1-t); not the project's direct ambient6D velocity head
mechanism.training_source: Official _corrupt_rotmats uses R0=R1*E with E sampled from IGSO3 sigma1.5; non-Haar finite-scale noise is centered relative to the label
mechanism.sampling_source: Rotation.random yields uniformSO3; no equivalent target-centered noise in inference
mechanism.schedules: Linear rotation training, exponential inference at exp_rate10; paper also clips endpoint loss scaling near t1
mechanism.source_caveat: Right multiplying Haar noise by a target would preserve its distribution; target dependence must be assessed at the law level. The reviewed alternative is IGSO3, not Haar.
mechanism.pi_branch: Within approximately0.01rad of pi, sqrt diagonal of(I+R)/2 with row-derived signs approximates axis; this loses directed sign on some near-pi inputs. Exactpi logarithm remains nonunique.

project_transfer.retain: SO3 tangent angular velocities and group integration as one representation factor, with independently sampled matched Haar source and explicit R/T/beta metric
project_transfer.stop: Unchanged author near-pi branch and unqualified copying of source/schedule changes; no author code patching
project_transfer.do_not_copy: Protein zero-CoM/global invariance, Kabsch pre-alignment, IPA/self-conditioning stack; current output retains camera-anchored metric translation
project_transfer.control: Detached SciPy principal endpoint log plus torch.matrix_exp passes declared endpoint/time-JVP checks without rejecting sampled rotations; CPU target preparation only, no differentiable endpoint guidance or general smooth-log guarantee
project_transfer.G0_G1: This geometry result does not establish necessity/removal ofG0/G1/J. No independent observation information is introduced.
